description: Güterumschlag im Hafen in der Stadt Oldenburg is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Stadt Oldenburg (Oldb). Dargestellt wird der Güterumschlag insgesamt in Tonnen und die Veränderung zum Vorjahr in Prozent. Berücksichtigt werden die Jahre ab 1953. Seit 2007 wird der Bahnumschlag in der Güterumschlagstatistik mitberücksichtigt. Coverage: Stadt Oldenburg (Oldb). The portal files it under the publisher Stadt Oldenburg (Oldb). Its tags are güterumschlag, hafen, hvd, statistik, transport-und-verkehr. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/CSV, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PDF. The portal shows 2026-05-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
